# Spotting and avoiding common scams


nsave team


Dec 24, 2025


Scammers often create urgency, impersonate a trusted organisation or ask you to move a conversation away from official support channels.


## Warning signs


- A message asks for a password, full card details or one-time security code.
- Someone pressures you to transfer immediately or keep the payment secret.
- A link uses a misspelled or unfamiliar domain.
